data.body:
[P2] Account for SDK failures before inferring a user cause

`ErrorObject.from_exception()` leaves data and stack trace unset for ordinary exceptions, so this execution-wide search commonly matches only the message. If a handled step fails with `ValueError("x")` and a later child fails with SDK `ValidationError("x")`, the actual SDK failure is excluded here, and the terminal `ChildContextError` is incorrectly reported as the earlier `ValueError`. Include matching non-wrapper SDK failures in the ambiguity check and retain the wrapper when the originating error cannot be established. Add a regression with a handled failure followed by an SDK failure sharing its message.
